description: What a Line on security.sbom-import reads: one SBOM file in the workspace and the source label it is recorded under; one Line per SBOM file. Each component's occurrence takes the CycloneDX scope the SBOM states (required when it states none). A scope other than required, optional or excluded is refused for that component, which keeps the scope it held; a purl listed twice with two scopes writes nothing for that purl.

logical_source.description: Source label the SBOM Capture and its derived component list are recorded under, lowercase (the template uses cyclonedx.sbom.app). Give each SBOM Line its own; evidence requirements and landing Triggers can name it.

relative_path.description: Workspace-relative path of one CycloneDX JSON SBOM (bomFormat CycloneDX; tested with spec 1.6): at most 1 MiB and 20000 components, nested at most 16 levels deep. The root component's purl (metadata.component.purl) names the inventory; without one, the inventory is named by this path, so moving the file starts a new inventory. Every component needs a purl: one without is counted but not imported, and the run then retires nothing. A generator for the project's ecosystem writes the file (cyclonedx-py, syft, cdxgen); Cruxible does not.

name: security.sbom-import.params
